title: The Dolly House 8BR Sleeps 24 5min to DT
description:
The Original Dolly House is the Ultimate Group Destination in Nashville! 

TWO side-by-side homes completely themed to the Queen of Country, Dolly herself. This unique property includes 8 bedrooms, 6.5 baths, two top floor Champagne Bars with Nashville skyline views, multiple custom murals - perfect for your group pics, and professional design... All within minutes to Broadway! 

Free parking + Free WiFi + Free Netflix + Free Coffee & more!

The space
Layout (Home 1):

"The White Limozeen" • Queen bed with ensuite bathroom
"The 9 to 5" • Three Queen beds with ensuite bath and custom 'makeup room'
"The Jolene" • Two Single beds with full bath just steps away
"The Diamond Room" • Media room with 55" smart tv, neon selfie station, sofa bed, and rotating disco ball!
"The Bubbly Bar" •  Third floor patio bar with downtown skyline views

Layout (Home 2):

"The Dolly Suite" • Queen bed with ensuite bathroom
"The Johnny" • Three Queen beds with ensuite bath and custom 'makeup room'
"The Library Room" • Two Single beds with full bath just steps away
"The Rainbow Room" • Media room with 55" smart tv, selfie wall, and sofa bed
"The Champagne Bar" •  Third floor patio bar with downtown skyline views

Perks:

▶︎ Coffee + Creamer + Sugar provided
▶︎ Free parking (3 designated spaces + street parking)
▶︎ Hi-speed Internet
▶︎ Washer + Dryer available for use
▶︎ Soft, clean linens for each bed
▶︎ Fresh towels, shampoo, body wash and hair dryer provided
▶︎ 5-10 minute uber to Broadway hotspots

STR Permit # is listed in photo caption

Other things to note
If you have a smaller group would like to book one of these houses individually, you can find the individual listings at:
airbnb.com/h/thejolene and airbnb.com/h/dollydreamhouse :)
